query: WITH expired AS (SELECT email_lower FROM local_login_throttle WHERE (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= clock_timestamp()) AND clock_timestamp() - interval '15 minutes' >= ALL(completed_failures) ORDER BY updated_at, email_lower LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) DELETE FROM local_login_throttle AS throttle USING expired WHERE throttle.email_lower = expired.email_lower AND (throttle.locked_until IS NULL OR throttle.locked_until <= clock_timestamp()) AND clock_timestamp() - interval '15 minutes' >= ALL(throttle.completed_failures)
